method: Read-only disassembly of the retained measured Release executable; no rebuild or execution.
finding: The timed direct32 random-throughput loop contains four query-ordinal pair loads, eight scalar indexed 32-bit data loads, eight independent 64-bit sums, query-pointer advancement and a backward branch. The expected checksum loop precedes the start clock. No loop elimination, reused expected sum or SIMD gather was observed. This establishes the measured independent-load throughput, not serialized lookup latency.
